proposals.quote: (3) Construction goals are 10 percent women, 40 percent minorities and 10 percent service-disabled veterans.

Bally’s plans to meet with all members of the project team to communicate its diversity hiring goals. Bally’s will also work closely with the New York City Building & Construction Trades Council within the confines of a project labor agreement to create a pipeline of diverse candidates.
Further, Bally’s will provide administrative assistance to the project team in pursuit of hiring qualified MWBEs and SDVOBs as both prime and subcontractors.

Bally’s plans to utilize pre-apprenticeship programs, partnerships with organizations such as the National Association of Black Women in Construction and African American Contractors Association, and job postings to recruit qualified MWBEs and SDVOBs.

Bally’s will incorporate tracking of its ongoing success outcomes through quarterly reporting on contractor diversity participation rates, attendance tracking at outreach events, digital engagement metrics, and annual reviews.
